scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu crouched by the stall's back wall, steam rising from glasses nearby, white envelope half out of her tote, thumb rubbing its edge
scenes.camera: static close on hands and envelope, pulling back to medium as she stands

dialogue.line: Two thousand rupees. For telling the truth.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: hands shake slightly, she glances at the stall boy, zips envelope fully into tote, counts coins for chai twice
scenes.narrative_job: continue cliffhanger physically, mundane anchor cash handling, decision crystallizing

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu alone in the elevator, tote hugged to her chest, catching her own reflection in the mirrored panel

dialogue.line: Keep it. Just don't tell Priya.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: she mouths the line first, then says it out loud, winces at how it sounds, looks away from the mirror
scenes.narrative_job: Anu accepts the unspoken deal internally

scenes.keyframe_visual: Priya at her desk with the shared tracker open on her monitor, Anu arriving with her lunch dabba
scenes.camera: static wide establishing desks, slow push to two-shot across the desk

dialogue.line: Your dabba's getting cold. Sit, eat.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: This slide error... I'll just mark it mine.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: Priya, that's my mistake, not yours.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: I know whose it is. Just eat, before I change my mind.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

scenes.micro_acting: Priya types fast, deletes Anu's name, retypes her own without looking up, then pushes the dabba back across the desk
scenes.narrative_job: reversal - Priya covers Anu's mistake unprompted, value-turn to owing silence, Priya's contradiction of protecting while preaching honesty

scenes.location: corridor outside Vikram's cabin, near the pantry
scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun by the pantry with an unopened protein bar, clock past 7pm, Vikram's blinds drawn and door shut down the corridor
scenes.camera: static wide down the corridor, slow push to close on Arjun's phone

dialogue.line: Door's shut again. Second time this week.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: What are you two even talking about?
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

scenes.micro_acting: he unwraps the bar without eating it, pulls out his phone, thumb hovers over a blank message to Anu, then pockets it unsent
